about_the_game:
STORY

You play as the High Priestess MARY, whose mission is to defend the statue of the Mother Goddess ALEA.

If the statue is destroyed by the elves, the kingdom of Saint Aquinas will fall before the cursed army of the great sorceress HERA.

DIVINE POWER

You can request the support of the goddess Alea with the Prayer skill to accumulate divine power.

This divine power will allow you to perform miracles:

You can summon divine soldiers from the blessed army; among them are divine knights and nuns of blessing.

You can heal all the soldiers of your sacred guard individually or in groups.

You can create a divine image of yourself to block the attackers' movements.

You can communicate with all your soldiers at the same time to summon them to your side.

GAMEPLAY

After a while, a group of enemies will appear and rush towards the statue to destroy it. You can't attack enemies yourself; for that, you need the Holy Soldiers!

As you progress, you'll gain experience and increase your power level.

This will help you improve your skills and those of your Blessed Guard.

IN THIS DEMO YOU WON'T FIND THE FOLLOWINGS FEATURES:

You don't have access to the upgrades menu where you can unlock up to 7 skins.

New game interface/main menu UI and HUD

Ennemies such as the sexy Dark pugilist, the Sorceress.

New unit: Jeanne the Sainte Vaillante, a DPS unit that appears for 60 seconds after 800 seconds of unavailability.

content_descriptors.notes: The main character is not completely covered by clothes. It looks like a bikini with some armor.

short_description: In BLEST, you are responsible for defending the sacred statue. You must use all your wits and the goddess's divine power to eliminate all the monsters that enter through the cathedral's main gate. May the goddess be with you!
